visual_action: A slideshow of computer-generated architectural renderings shows a large, modern airport. Images depict the airport's exterior at sunset, the main entrance, a spacious interior lobby with high ceilings and large windows, a concourse with seating areas and a bar, and an overhead view of the parking lot and terminals.
